title: A basket chosen all at once
hook: Two stated cases: explore the menu composition of a planned basket.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the menu composition of a planned basket affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines StockMoney, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the menu composition of a planned basket in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.

claims.text: A toy investor splits 10 equally across 3 stock funds and 2 bond funds. How much goes to stocks?
